import Mathlib
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Munkres_exercise_18_8a {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
  [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y] {f g : X → Y}
  (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g) :
  IsClosed {x | f x ≤ g x} := by
  have hC : IsClosed {p : Y × Y | p.1 ≤ p.2} := by
    apply isOpen_compl_iff.mp
    have heq : ({p : Y × Y | p.1 ≤ p.2}ᶜ) = {p : Y × Y | p.2 < p.1} := by
      ext p
      simp [not_le]
    rw [heq]
    apply isOpen_prod_iff.mpr
    intro a b hab
    by_cases hex : ∃ c, b < c ∧ c < a
    · obtain ⟨c, hbc, hca⟩ := hex
      refine ⟨Ioi c, Iio c, isOpen_Ioi, isOpen_Iio, hca, hbc, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      have hp' : c < p.1 ∧ p.2 < c := by
        simpa [Set.mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Iio] using hp
      exact hp'.2.trans hp'.1
    · refine ⟨Ioi b, Iio a, isOpen_Ioi, isOpen_Iio, hab, hab, ?_⟩
      intro p hp
      have hp' : b < p.1 ∧ p.2 < a := by
        simpa [Set.mem_prod, mem_Ioi, mem_Iio] using hp
      by_contra hnp
      exact hex ⟨p.1, hp'.1, lt_of_le_of_lt (le_of_not_gt hnp) hp'.2⟩
  exact IsClosed.preimage (hf.prodMk hg) hC
